scope: Tissues were homogenized in ice cold lysis buffer (1% NP40, 0,1% sodium deoxycholate, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA and 50 mM TrisHCl, pH 7.5) using a rotor–stator homogenizer.

After centrifugation (15 min, 4 °C, 20,000g) the supernatant was separated and kept on ice.
